w: In the evening assembly the Mayor of City of Pico Rivera - Mr.Garth Gardener and the Mayor of Lynwood - Mr.Louis Byrd welcomed Swamishri with bouquets. Mayor Louis Byrd presented Swamishri with the Key to the City of Lynwood.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj departs from London After 21 memorable days in London, Swamishri left for Johannesburg. Countless devotees crowded the mandir complex for Swamishri's darshan, Swamishri briefly addressed the devotees in the haveli. After arriving at London's Heathrow Airport, he boarded flight SA235 destined for Johannesburg, South Africa.

w: Yesterday a yagna was held for the consecration ceremony of new murtis at the San Jose hari mandir. Today Swamishri presided over the murti-pratishtha rituals at the newly built BAPS hari mandir. Tyagvallabh Swami performed the rituals of the marble murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Ishwarcharan Swami performed the rituals of Radha-Krishna Dev, Viveksagar Swami performed the rituals of the Guru Parampara, Yagneshwar Swami for Sita-Ram and Hanumanji, Yagnavallabh Swami for Shiv-Parvati and Ganapatji and Dharmacharan Swami performed the rituals of Nilkanth Varni. In conclusion Swamishri invoked the presence of God in the murtis, performed the pujan ritual and finally arti. Thereafter Swamishri presided over the pratishtha assembly. The senior sadhus addressed the audience, and balaks, kishores and yuvaks performed a cultural dance to commemorate the function. Then the Mayor of Milpitas, Jose Esteves, addressed the assembly, “Jai Swaminarayan. Namaste. Om Shanti. I am very happy to be here. I want to welcome you to the beautiful city of Milpitas. With the mandir the city will become more beautiful. I want to express my gratitude for all that you do. Today is even more special because we have with us the presence of HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj.” The Mayor presented a Key to the City to Swamishri. Former Mayor and present supervisor, Pete McHugh, said, “Congratulations on the successful completion of the BAPS Centenary and best wishes for a bright future of BAPS and its aura of spiritual enlightenment, harmony and world peace. And congratulations on the successful inauguration of the new BAPS mandir, where Swamishri has kindly invited Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj to be present with BAPS gurus and other favourite deities.” He then presented a certificate of recognition to Swamishri. The Mayor of Sunnyvale City, Otto Lee, said, “Today is a very wonderful day for BAPS mandir and cultural complex to have this wonderful opening. Because of 100 years of charitable work this organization has done to bring food, to bring shelter, and most important, to bring comfort to those in dire need around the world. BAPS is most highly commended for this wonderful effort for the past century, bringing peace and freedom of suffering from all around the world.” Thereafter the Mayor presented a proclamation to Swamishri. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “The mandir is beautiful and thousands will benefit from it. Today many feel that money is wasted in making mandirs. One should spend them in social services. We need hospitals, schools and colleges in society. If one were to think deeper one would see that we also need mandirs because through them we are cured of mental problems and frustrations.” At 6.00 pm Swamishri departed from San Jose and landed at Chino Hills airport, LA, at 7.00 pm. Swamishri was welcomed by BAPS sadhus and the Mayor of Chino Hills, Curt Hagmann, and Councilmen Bill Krueger and Gary Larson. During Swamishri’s stay volunteer devotees of different suburbs and cities gave satsang activity reports: Serritos, Arteeziya, Fullston, San Fernando Valley, South Orange County, Inland Empire, Victorville, Bastro, Corona, North Orange County and Anaheim. The evening assemblies were celebrated as Swagat Day and Kishore Day (9/9), Youth Day (11/9), Murti-Pratishtha Day (15/9) and Children’s Day (16/9).

Shastriji Maharaj’s Memorial Day: Swamishri came for Thakorji’s darshan prior to his morning puja. In the central shrine of the mandir a scene of Dada Khachar’s darbar was displayed. The murtis of paramhansas were arranged with bowls of dudhpak before them. The entire ambience was related to the commemoration. When Swamishri came on stage he was welcomed by a traditional dance and bhajans on the glory of Shastriji Maharaj. A panel of large photoprints on canvas, mainly on Shastriji Maharaj, spanned across the stage in memory of Swamishri’s guru. During Swamishri’s morning puja sadhus sang bhajans in praise of Shastriji Maharaj. Thereafter senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri. Swamishri then blessed the devotees, “We heard about Shastriji Maharaj’s extraordinary work in the kirtans that have been sung just now. He was a great person who came on earth and accomplished a unique mission. We have all gathered here because of him. This celebration is important because it has a divine association. Shastriji Maharaj explained the principles of upasana . His mission was genuine and he preached the truth. He made mandirs, shastras and sadhus for us. He consecrated the murtis of Akshar and Purushottam in mandirs.”More than 19,000 devotees were served mahaprasad after Swamishri’s morning puja.
